planets.name: TOI-1224 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1224 with a 17.9-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-1224 c was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-1224. Its orbit and size follow Thao et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
